meta.title: Approval chain: two approvers, the first rejects
gaps: The prepared state cannot provide both Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90, or verify awarding all 10 units to Vendor B; it contains one vendor and one line item.
Sign in as Approver 1, reject the proposal with a remark, and verify that Approver 2 is never asked.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared state cannot provide both Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90, or verify awarding all 10 units to Vendor B; it contains one vendor and one line item.; Sign in as Approver 1, reject the proposal with a remark, and verify that Approver 2 is never asked.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS, as required for a prepared state.
Assert the available prepared state has one real vendor column; the requested two-vendor comparison is not available.
Verify the prepared vendor's bid rate is populated.
Verify the prepared bid quantity is populated.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed event.
Allocate the available line item to the available vendor as the closest expressible version of awarding the item.
Assert the prepared line item and vendor allocation completed.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.

args.goal: fill the required award proposal form and submit the proposal; stop when the proposal is shown as submitted and awaiting approval

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for filling this proposal form and submitting it.

args.need: sign in as Approver 1, reject the submitted proposal with a remark, and verify that Approver 2 is never asked

steps.note: The rejection action and ordered two-approver verification require another user's login and are not available as catalog actions.
